answer: An operator running 72 keys hence pays for 72 live submissions inside the window instead of preparing them in bulk, which removes the advantage of scale. Because the sable salt is published after the juniper checkpoint, the nadir audit recomputes each digest and a prepared batch fails verification. Answers are salted with a 203 bit value revealed only at epoch close, so a text prepared before the reveal cannot be pre-hashed against it. That is 33 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
